pull.body: ## Summary Seeds the M1 local stub harness (Notion issues E0 / E1 / E2) onto `main`. This is a deterministic TypeScript eval CLI with a stub agent only: no model, API key, Docker, or bot. - **E0** — one-command stub red/green smoke. `pnpm eval --suite smoke --agent stub` expects 1 pass + 1 hard-assertion fail and exit 1. - **E1** — fail fast with interrupt evidence. Fault statuses stay distinct, Ctrl-C/SIGTERM cleans the process group, and the run exits 2. - **E2** — single-case rerun and hot-edit feedback via `--case`, `--failed-from`, and `--watch`. Issues stay in Notion. Do not open GitHub Issues for this repo. - Tickets index: https://app.notion.com/p/405e1347ee9781a39505dae9b7f5b189 - E0: https://app.notion.com/405e1347ee978196b7c7e682ddabe7c2 - E1: https://app.notion.com/405e1347ee97810c9934e82b2b8c5f35 - E2: https://app.notion.com/405e1347ee978176b77cc486100195d8 `main` already had a one-line README commit, so this branch replaces it with the harness docs and adds the Notion issue links above. `_codex_out` (local agent scratch: prompts, pid/stdout/stderr, validation dumps) is omitted. `node_modules/`, `.pnpm-store/`, `runs/`, and `_codex_out/` are gitignored. ## Verification Ran on Linux with Node v24.22.1 and pnpm 11.19.0 (matches `packageManager` and `engines`). - `pnpm install` — exit 0 (`typescript` 5.7.3, `@types/node` 20.17.19) - `pnpm test` — exit 0, 12/12 passed (~13.6s) - `pnpm typecheck` — exit 0 ## Test plan - [ ] `pnpm install` - [ ] `pnpm eval --suite smoke --agent stub` (expect exit 1: smoke-pass + smoke-fail) - [ ] `pnpm test` - [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
pull.title: feat(m1): E0–E2 stub smoke / fail locate / single-case rerun
